description: A stereo fuzz modelled on the diode version of the Maestro MFZ-1, with a CV input and an attenuverter on each of its three controls

params.text: Switches the fuzz out of the signal path, passing the inputs through
Sets the tone of the fuzz
Sets how hard the signal is driven into the fuzz
Sets the output level of the fuzz
An attenuverter setting how far the voltage at the FILTER CV jack moves the filter
An attenuverter setting how far the voltage at the DRIVE CV jack moves the drive
An attenuverter setting how far the voltage at the VOLUME CV jack moves the level

inputs.text: The left side of the signal into the fuzz
The right side of the signal into the fuzz
A trigger switches the fuzz out of the path and back in
A voltage added to the filter setting, scaled by the attenuverter on that row
A voltage added to the drive, scaled by the attenuverter on that row
A voltage added to the output level, scaled by the attenuverter on that row

outputs.text: The left side of the fuzzed signal
The right side of the fuzzed signal
